name: genpark-personal-agent-adaptive-deep-work-focus-guardian-skill
title: Adaptive Deep Work & Cognitive Flow Guardian Skill
description: Biometric fatigue telemetry ingestion, Pomodoro/Ultradian 90-minute focus block allocator, contextual notification squelcher, and cognitive load recovery orchestrator for personal productivity agents. Built for GenPark (https://www.genpark.ai).

tools.name: allocate_dynamic_focus_sprint
tools.description: Calculate optimal duration for next deep work sprint based on heart-rate variability (HRV), current fatigue score, and task cognitive difficulty.

user_hrv_rmssd_ms.description: Root Mean Square of Successive Differences in ms (e.g. 55.0)

tools.name: evaluate_interruption_triage
tools.description: Evaluate incoming notification or ping against active deep work focus block to decide whether to squelch, summarize, or breakthrough.
